description: Run read-only ClickHouse SQL over one website's published analytics tables. Use it for what get_data query types cannot express: all-time bounds, custom grouping, joins across tables, ordered paths.

params.description: Values for {name:Type} placeholders. websiteId and websiteDomain are bound to the selected website and cannot be overridden.

sql.description: One SELECT or WITH query without comments, comma joins or table functions. Rows are already limited to the selected website. Page views are analytics.events rows with event_name = 'screen_view'; analytics.events uses time, analytics.revenue uses created, other tables use timestamp. Count visitors with uniq(anonymous_id). Put values in {name:Type} placeholders.

websiteDomain.description: Or its domain, such as example.com.

name: execute_sql_query

outputSchema.description: columns gives each result column's ClickHouse type. rows holds the first 100 rows that fit in 64 KB of JSON; list values keep the first 50 items and the row's truncatedArrays gives their full lengths. truncated is true when more rows existed than rows holds, and rowCount is then a lower bound, not a total: count with count(), aggregate, or add LIMIT, as hint says.

title: Run read-only SQL
